title: Pointwise degree domination implies degree-majorisation
statement: Let $G$ and $H$ be simple graphs on a common finite vertex set $V$. If every vertex has at least as high a degree in $H$ as in $G$, that is $d_G(v) \le d_H(v)$ for all $v \in V$, then $G$ is degree-majorised by $H$.
hypotheses_covered: G and H are simple graphs on the same finite vertex set V
d_G(v) ≤ d_H(v) for every vertex v
